note: Read with git show f2c9e36e:frontend/public/sw.js (identical to the working tree at spec time). Nothing was built or run, so every verdict is a source reading.

SCN-WRK-001.evidence: sw.js:4 one cache 'uar-v1'; activate (sw.js:22-31) deletes only other names; cache-first puts every /assets/ response (sw.js:64) into uar-v1, so A-only entries remain after C.

SCN-WRK-002.evidence: Baseline never evicts, and offline navigations fall back to caches.match(request) then /index.html (sw.js:80-88) while assets are cache-first (sw.js:50-64), so the current build renders offline. The oracle only forbids over-eviction. Non-triviality: the control (offline reload in a fresh context that never visited online) must show the offline error page and an empty root; the runner must fail if it renders.

SCN-WRK-003.evidence: The oracle requires an A-only file to fail offline; the baseline keeps A-only files in uar-v1 (sw.js:64) and serves them cache-first, so the fetch succeeds.

SCN-WRK-004.evidence: Baseline sw.js:4 creates 'uar-v1'; the oracle requires no cache named uar-v1 after the upgrade, and the baseline never deletes it (sw.js:22-31 keeps CACHE_NAME).

SCN-WRK-005.evidence: sw.js:50-56 serves any .svg and .js path cache-first with no revalidation, so the changed favicon and /probe.js bytes are not served after the deploy.

SCN-WRK-006.evidence: sw.js:73-80 stores each ok navigation under its own request key including the query string; 20 distinct URLs leave about 20 HTML entries against the expected 1.

SCN-WRK-007.evidence: sw.js:36-45 already returns early for non-GET, /api/, /v1/ and /metrics, so no bypass URL is cached and stream latency is unchanged. Non-triviality: the mutant worker (new sw.js with the marker block removed) is run on the new build and must cache the probe URLs; the baseline has no markers, so no mutant is derived from it. The runner must fail if the mutant run does not reject, and the scenario is BLOCKED if a probe URL does not return 200.

SCN-WRK-009.evidence: git grep for uar:catalog in frontend/src at the baseline finds nothing, so the required uar:catalog-project and uar:catalog-filter measures do not exist (models-page.tsx:110,136 have no performance marks) and the oracle rejects.
